name: Create External Provider User
summary: Creates one durable identity from an OAuth-external PendingIdentity only after independent email proof and duplicate checks, attaches the provider subject, and leaves application authorization for later session establishment.

sourceState.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and pending-identity-flow == oauth-external and credential-proof == oauth-proved and email-ownership == verified and durable-identity == absent and profile-completeness == complete

guards.expression: provider subject has no existing durable identity link

sourceReferences.note: Approved policy requires provider-subject-first resolution and independent NuvIoT email proof before linking an unlinked provider to an existing durable user.
PendingIdentity defines OAuthExternalLogin as a ceremony-only flow bucket.
External IdP V2 reconciliation retains provider protocols as implementation details beneath provider-independent auth semantics.
